_comment: Optara deployment config for monad-testnet (DEPLOYMENT.md §2-§3). Role addresses are the multisigs/timelock and MUST be filled in before deploying; Deploy.s.sol refuses zero addresses. pyth: verified on-chain 2026-10-07 (getUpdateFee, MON/USD feed). kuruRouter: Kuru's mainnet Router (verified on a mainnet fork, test/fork/KuruAdapter.fork.t.sol); zero on testnet, whose Kuru 'Spot V2' needs its own adapter.

redstone._comment: The signer set LiveSpotOracle accepts for signed price packages (on-chain kinds REDSTONE_DIRECT / REDSTONE_DERIVED) and how many distinct ones a feed needs: RedStone's redstone-primary-prod signers (from RedStone's SDK, checked 2026-10-12) plus Optara's testnet price node signers (priceNode.signers, added 2026-10-15). Listings re-apply this set, so it must stay a superset of priceNode.signers.

priceNode._comment: Optara's testnet price node (pricenode/, a Cloudflare Worker): MON/USD and USDC/USD as signed price packages in the on-chain format LiveSpotOracle verifies (RedStone's). urls: where the publisher, keepers and markets.sh fetch them (PRICE_NODE_URLS overrides); signers: the node's keys, which governance adds to LiveSpotOracle's signer set (the redstone section); threshold: distinct signers per feed. Replaces RedStone's public gateways, switched off in October 2026. TESTNET ONLY: whoever holds these keys sets MON's price.
